europe_now.title: EU Lawmakers Accuse Chinese Officials of Intimidation Over Taiwan
europe_now.summary: European Union lawmakers have formally accused Chinese officials of intimidation regarding Taiwan-related matters. The diplomatic friction unfolds as broader discussions take place concerning international relations and economic dependencies in Asia.

sources.headline: EU lawmakers accuse Chinese officials of intimidation over Taiwan

europe_now.title: Germany Presses to Make Ukraine Aid Le Pen-Proof
europe_now.summary: German officials are actively working on measures to safeguard future financial and military support for Ukraine against potential political shifts in France. The initiative aims to maintain consistent international assistance despite changing domestic leadership landscapes.

sources.headline: Germany presses to make Ukraine aid Le Pen-proof
